Description:
!https://qtm4j-cloud-prod-4.s3.amazonaws.com/client/5201/project/10356/TESTCASE/adbGsRjDcLMRb9/7257089/TC-583_1681704868684_COJiR8ieJZ_JNwYUhq8Td.png Navigate to the Overview module of Home root box in Hierarchy mode and search for boxName.
   Data: boxName: TC-583 Feature area - Box - Box parent changing - Creating sequential Sub-box
   Expected: Home root box is displayed on the Box switcher.
The Overview module name is marked as active on the header grid.
The Hierarchy mode icon is active.
"TC-583 Feature area - Box - Box parent changing - Creating sequential Sub-box" is displayed on the Overview of Home root box as a sub-box of Home.
2. Click on the + button (Add new) beLow boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-583 Feature area - Box - Box parent changing - Creating sequential Sub-box
   Expected: Add dialog on Box level is opened.
3. Click on the Indent the level button.
   Expected: Add dialog is switched to the Sub-box level.
4. Select boxType, fill boxName, select startDate and endDate.
   Data: boxType: TC-583 Child
boxName: TC-583 Child 2
startDate: 01/Jan/23
endDate: 31/Jan/23
   Expected: Box type is set to TC-583 Child. Box name is TC-583 Child 2. Start date is 01/Jan/23. End date is 31/Jan/23.
5. Click on the Create button.
   Expected: Sub-box is not created. A validation error is displayed with the folLowing message: 
"TC-584 Child 2 period cannot overlap with TC-583 Child"
